scope: Unchanged released decoders (decodeFullAnnotator) of a transaction body, witness set or whole transaction at the era's decoder version (Allegra 3, Mary 4, Alonzo 5, Babbage 7, Conway 9): the map form of an output and of a collateral return (Babbage, Conway; Alonzo has none) and Conway's map form of redeemers, each with its length in the head and in one, two, four and eight bytes; as controls the eight-byte head of an output's and of redeemers' list form, of a multi-asset map, of metadata and of a metadatum map, which the reference reads; no ledger rule, signature or script is run
referenceNode: 11.1.3 (matching embedded ledger package versions, not a bit-identical node release build)

babbageTxOut.note: decodeBabbageTxOut: the map form for TypeMapLenIndef and TypeMapLen, the list form otherwise (549-553)

alonzoTxWits.note: RedeemersRaw from decoder version 9: decodeMapRedeemers for TypeMapLenIndef and TypeMapLen, decodeListRedeemers otherwise (548-559)
